# AmbarksCloud Docs (for LLMs/Agents)

These docs describe AmbarksCloud deploy workflows, configuration files, and troubleshooting. Prefer authoritative pages below.

## Entry points

- Home: `index.mdx`
- Quickstart: `inicio/quickstart.mdx`
- Runtimes: `projetos/runtimes.mdx`
- ambarks.json: `projetos/ambarks-json.mdx`
- Env vars: `projetos/variaveis-ambiente.mdx`
- Ports/domains: `projetos/portas-dominios.mdx`
- Logs/metrics: `projetos/logs-metricas.mdx`
- Containers: `projetos/containers.mdx`
- Plans/limits: `projetos/billing-limites.mdx`
- Guides: `guias/visao-geral.mdx`
- Troubleshooting: `troubleshooting/common-errors.mdx`
- FAQ: `faq.mdx`

## Key concepts

- Deploy sources: ZIP upload or GitHub repo
- Runtime-based deploy: Node.js, Python, PHP, Rust, static sites
- Custom commands via `ambarks.json` (JSON Schema included)
- App exposure via internal port + bind `0.0.0.0`
- Secrets via environment variables

## Common tasks

- "How do I deploy X?": start at `guias/visao-geral.mdx`
- "My app is up but not reachable": check `projetos/portas-dominios.mdx`, then `troubleshooting/common-errors.mdx`
- "Build fails": check `troubleshooting/common-errors.mdx` + `projetos/ambarks-json.mdx`
